descriptions.employee: Basic access for signing in and using the platform.
descriptions.system_admin: Manages login accounts, role assignments, the access audit and branding settings.
descriptions.vendor_support: Vendor support access for operating the environment on request.
descriptions.pmo_manager: Manages projects, tasks, approvals and project settings.
descriptions.hr_manager: Manages the HR directory, departments and documents.
descriptions.appointments_manager: Manages appointment types, bookings and appointment settings.
descriptions.finance_manager: Manages accounting, invoices, payments, banking and finance settings.
descriptions.finance_accountant: Records entries, invoices and payments and performs daily accounting work.
descriptions.finance_auditor: Read-only view of financial records and the audit log.
descriptions.documents_manager: Manages documents, their folders and who can access them.
descriptions.operations_manager: Manages operations, approvals and operations settings.
descriptions.operations_reviewer: Reviews operations requests and approves or rejects them.
descriptions.inbox_agent: Replies to the customer inbox conversations assigned to them.
descriptions.inbox_supervisor: Monitors customer inbox conversations and distributes them to agents.
descriptions.inbox_manager: Manages the customer inbox, its channels, templates and settings.
descriptions.crm_agent: Follows up the leads assigned to them and logs their activity.
descriptions.crm_manager: Manages leads: assignment, import, export and CRM settings.
descriptions.payroll_manager: Manages payroll, salary structures and approves payroll runs.
